claims.quote: The extremely pointed toe was called a winkle picker because, in England, periwinkle snails ("winkles") were a popular seaside snack which is eaten using a pin or other thin pointed object to carefully extract the soft parts out of the coiled shell.
Winklepickers, inspired by the Polish poulaines worn by the medieval French nobility, were a conspicuous contrast to the brothel creepers worn by Teddy Boys.
